title: Son and Heir
pitch: Jasper Wren runs Varga business out of his father's house, on Victor's hill. Victor wants twelve hundred and an apology.

clue_a.label: The fountain
lines: A sandwich bag of wet notes wedged under the fountain's lip, banded in Varga red. Jasper's drop, in his father's garden.

clue_b.label: His father's car
lines: A letter from the family lawyer in the glovebox. One more incident and Jasper is cut off. Signed by his father.
